issues.message: 419 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Inside is well furnished (hearth, two tables, bar of kegs, six beds up a staircase) but the outside is only a door, plain windows and corner posts: no sills, no props, nothing small on any face.
notes.purpose: From outside it reads as a generic two-storey house; only the interior says inn.
notes.depth: Stone-brick plinth, oak corner posts, dark oak beam band and roof overhang break every face.
notes.roof: Steep spruce roof with dark oak eaves, a dark oak plank ridge, 1-block overhang at the eaves and the gables.
notes.materials: Cobble/mossy cobble, stone bricks, oak logs, dark oak logs, spruce roof, oak floors, white terracotta gable and brick chimney: about 8 materials. White terracotta reads pink-beige rather than plaster.
notes.shape: A plain rectangle with a chimney; the upper storey is inside the roof, so the outline is a box with a roof.
notes.life: Only mossy cobble; no plants, lanterns, path or fence outside.

visual.summary: L1 is the shell: a stone common room with hearth, tables and a keg bar, and six beds in the attic storey up a staircase, under a steep spruce roof with a brick chimney.
problems: Exterior is bare at L1: give this level its own outside detail that L2/L3 don't already add, e.g. slab or stair window sills under the front windows (3,2,1) and (7,2,1) and the side windows, and a short cobble/gravel path continuing from the step at (5,0,1).
Nothing outside says 'inn' at L1 (sign and stable only come at L2); a bench or a pair of kegs beside the door would help purpose without stealing L2's extras.
Reachability: common room, staircase and upper floor are reached (159 of 227 places); the unreached places are roof slopes and the chimney top/shoulders, which is fine.
